questions.prompt: After the summary replaces messages 1 to 3, what is true of the record?
options: Messages 1 to 3 are deleted from it
It still holds messages 1 to 3, plus the new summary events
Messages 1 to 3 are rewritten as the summary
questions.explanation: The record is append-only. The replacement is a new event; only the surface stops listing seqs 1, 2 and 3.

questions.prompt: The surface is [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]. A user/message with seq 10 replaces 1 to 3. What is the surface now?
questions.explanation: The replace takes the place of the range in the same position, so seq 10 sits between the system prompt and message 4.

questions.prompt: Why is compaction/start appended before the summary request and compaction/end after everything else?
options: A start without an end shows that the work did not finish
The provider needs both events to make a summary
The end event pays for the summary's tokens
The start event changes the surface
questions.explanation: If the program stops part way, the record has a start without an end, so the harness can see the summary never landed.

diagramRequest.title: Replacing three messages with a summary
diagramRequest.show: The surface holds messages 1-3 (2,150 tokens). compaction/start goes into the record, the range goes to the model in one request, a 250-token summary comes back, is recorded and replaces the range in the surface, then compaction/end is appended.
